text: Automated, context-aware code reviews that catch bugs and enforce coding standards

text: CLI-based AI code review before commit, catching race conditions, memory leaks, and security vulnerabilities
quote: Get AI code reviews directly in your CLI before you commit. Catch race conditions, memory leaks, and security vulnerabilities without leaving your development environment.

text: Prioritizes PR queue by value/risk and routes each pull request to the right reviewer

text: Summarizes large diffs as logical cohorts with range-specific summaries and diagrams showing how changes fit together

text: Separately metered Deep Scan analyzes full committed source and infra config for exploitable vulnerabilities and exposed secrets beyond the PR diff

text: Reviewer supports follow-up questions, clarifications, and challenging its recommendations in the PR thread

text: Teach the reviewer your team's review preferences using natural-language chat
quote: Teach CodeRabbit your review preferences using natural-language chat.

text: Path-specific instructions apply targeted review guidance (e.g. security checks for API controllers, coverage rules for tests)
quote: Path instructions apply targeted guidance to specific paths, such as security checks for API controllers, coverage requirements for tests, or clarity rules for documentation.

text: Supports review instructions defined as AST patterns via ast-grep
quote: CodeRabbit supports review instructions based on Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) patterns, powered by ast-grep

text: Auto-detects coding guideline files like .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md in the repo and applies them as review criteria

text: Link related repositories so the reviewer can detect breaking changes and API mismatches that cross repo boundaries

text: Connect MCP servers as a knowledge source so the reviewer can pull extra context from docs, design, and PM tools during review and chat

text: One-click agentic actions to fix findings, resolve merge conflicts, generate unit tests, simplify code, or run custom recipes on a PR

text: Incremental re-review on new commits vs. an explicit full review of the entire PR on command
quote: @coderabbitai review does incremental review (new changes), not a full review. Use @coderabbitai full review when you want a complete pass over the entire pull request.

text: Installs via existing GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, or Bitbucket account with no credit card required

text: Claude Code can trigger CodeRabbit reviews directly via commands, enabling build-review-fix loops without manual steps

text: Natural-language 'Investigate' mode to ask questions about the codebase, trace features, and cross-reference Sentry errors with merged PRs and Jira issues

text: A chat command returns the fully resolved review configuration in YAML for any PR
